note: The standard benches every model gets, so models are comparable. Adding or retiring a bench applies to future runs only.

benches.name: Speed reference
benches.what: Sky and code prompts, exact and skip 0.5, 12 threads

benches.name: Quality bench
benches.what: 24 graded prompts (facts, maths, logic, code with tests, explanations) x configs x normal/terse styles

benches.name: Quiet comparison
benches.what: Key speed cases repeated on a quiet machine

benches.name: RAM sweep
benches.what: Exact runs at larger RAM budgets
